_comment: Suites excluded from `yarn test:ci` (WP-A8). Every entry failed on the Track A baseline of 2026-09-23, before any Track A change touched it.
Remove an entry when its suite is fixed; add one only with a reason and an issue link. `yarn test` still runs everything.
This ledger is for suites that are broken. Suites that need live infrastructure are not broken and do not belong here - they are listed in test/integrationSuites.js and excluded by jest.config.ts.
A suite can be both: seed_apex needs live Mongo and Postgres AND is currently broken, so it appears in both places.

suites.reason: Source defect, not test drift. The spec asserts the ImageMacro is registered (alias 'image'); it is not. Commit a523647 added it to ai/macro/index.ts deliberately ('register ImageMacro in server registry'), 133bf07 restored it after an accidental drop, and 13a94ee removed it again as collateral in an unrelated hunk - it is now in no registry, so the image tool is no longer advertised to the model. Filed separately; do not relax the assertion.

Source defect, narrow. Hash is declared `(e: any): number` but Hash(null) returns null (typeof 'object'): the guard `!isNaN(unkType)` is satisfied because Number(null) === 0, so null is returned as if it were a number. The test encodes the correct contract. Filed separately; do not relax the assertion.

Source defect in workspace mode. An absolute subfolder path that is one of the workspace's own folders is not recognised (the workspace branch only returns for '/', '' or the workspace file/dir), so it falls through to an APP_DATA_ROOT listing and returns 0 files; and a missing workspace file falls through to the same listing (66 files) instead of degrading to empty. Filed separately; do not relax the assertions.

Broken as well as integration, so it is listed here and in test/integrationSuites.js. It cannot pass against an empty database: it inserts ReactoryClassroomClass through the raw repository without a clientKey, and the entity declares that column NOT NULL (@ClientKeyColumn defaults to nullable: false) - the value normally comes from the tenant repository wrapper, which this path bypasses. It only appears to pass where the 10A-10F rows it seeds already exist, because its findOne guard then skips the insert. Fix the insert (or use the tenant repository), then remove this entry.
